{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Correct the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter to loyal customers only
loyal_df = df[df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Check that no QA orders or refunded orders are in loyal segment
# QA orders have revenue = 999999.99
qa_in_loyal = loyal_df[loyal_df['revenue'] == 999999.99].shape[0]
refunded_in_loyal = loyal_df[loyal_df['status'] == 'refunded'].shape[0]

# Compute the conversion fraction
n_loyal = loyal_df.shape[0]
converted_loyal = loyal_df['converted'].sum()
conversion_fraction = converted_loyal / n_loyal

# Print results
print(f'Number of loyal customers: {n_loyal}')
print(f'Number converted: {converted_loyal}')
print(f'Conversion fraction: {conversion_fraction}')

# Report checks
print(f'QA orders in loyal segment: {qa_in_loyal}')
print(f'Refunded orders in loyal segment: {refunded_in_loyal}')"}
